title: The streak ends and the nWo reunites
summary: Kevin Nash becomes the challenger who ends Goldberg’s winning run, with help from Scott Hall. A promised rematch then becomes a scheme to restore Hogan and reunite the nWo.

chapters.title: Hall’s stun gun ends the streak
chapters.result: Nash defeats Goldberg to win the WCW World championship.
chapters.context: Hall’s interference supplies the opening for Nash’s victory, ending Goldberg’s advertised undefeated run.

chapters.title: The Fingerpoke of Doom
chapters.result: Nash lies down for Hogan, surrendering the world title.
chapters.context: A fictional arrest removes Goldberg from the advertised rematch. The title handoff reunites the nWo and leaves Goldberg facing the restored group.
